```yaml
name: comment-artifacts
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["test-build"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  comment-artifacts:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: test-build.yml
          commit: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Get PR number from commit
        id: get_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}/pulls" \
            | jq -r '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment PR with artifact links
        if: ${{ steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number != 'null' && steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number != '' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## 📦 Build Artifacts
            
            **ISO Artifacts:**
            - [grml-live-build-result-initial-bookworm](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000000) 
            - [grml-live-build-result-initial-trixie](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000001)
            - [grml-live-build-result-repack-bookworm](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000002)
            - [grml-live-build-result-repack-trixie](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000003)
            
            **Debian Package Artifacts:**
            - [deb-unstable](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000004)
            - [deb-trixie](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000005)
            - [deb-bookworm](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/1000000006)
            
            These artifacts were built from commit ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}.
          mode: upsert
```
